answer: PoA resists Sybil creation by binding each agent identity to a remote-attestation report and hardware-protected key, with MRENCLAVE confirming approved enclave code. Because MRENCLAVE alone is not device-unique, enrollment must also detect reused hardware credentials. Creating more identities then requires additional genuine hardware, rather than simply duplicating virtual machines. A gale may cross the lagoon, but it cannot replicate the jetty’s trusted hardware.
